title: Pericardiotomy & phrenic nerve
view: Adult male supine, from directly above, head at the top, the patient's right on the image left; the approved decompression torso with a cutaway window over the left chest.
teachingPoint: Left anterolateral incision in the 4th-5th space on the upper edge of the rib below; open the pericardium longitudinally, anterior to the phrenic nerve.
claims: Male torso from above, the left chest on the image right (house laterality; the record names the left side).

Incision along the 5th intercostal space on the upper edge of the 6th rib, from the left sternal edge to the lateral chest wall (record: 4th-5th space, superior rib margin, sternal edge to the table).
Phrenic nerve along the lateral surface of the pericardium (record, anatomy).
Pericardiotomy longitudinal and anterior (medial in this view) to the phrenic nerve, about 2 cm from it (record, step 5; the spacing is drawn).
Pericardium outline: left border from the 2nd space near the sternum to the apex at the 5th space near the midclavicular line (standard anatomy, added).
Translucent rib cage: the decompression plate's fitted geometry (owner-approved, 2026-10-02).
Labels: Incision, 4th-5th ICS; Phrenic nerve; Pericardiotomy; Pericardium.
